summary.text: Kemp Strickler is a Democratic member of the Missouri House of Representatives who has represented District 34 since January 2023 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Republican Sean Smith is also on the general election ballot.

paragraphs.text: Strickler was assigned to the House Administration and Accounts and Ways and Means committees and the Joint Committee on Tax Policy for 2025-2026.
In 2023-2024 he served on the Downsizing State Government and Higher Education committees.
